task_definition.task_description: Could you check the current time in New York? Then, please query the connected locks in the living room and diagnose the health of my devices (the main lock, living room light, AC, and TV) to see if any are offline. After that, get the discovered lock ticket for the living room and archive it for user_123 with high priority through the app, using the New York timezone as the title. Finally, turn off the living room light.

user_input.query: Could you tell me the current time for the America/New_York timezone? Once you have that, please query the connected locks in the living_room. I also need you to diagnose the health of my devices—the main lock, living room light, AC, and TV—to see if any are currently offline. After checking the devices, get the discovered lock ticket for the living_room and archive it through the app with high priority for user_123. Make sure to use America/New_York as the title for the archive. Finally, please turn off the living room light, which has the ID light_living.
